mission: Audit edge cases POS production-real non-couverts
verdict_summary: 6/6 edges PASS, 5/5 adversarial probes blocked correctly. NF525 chain bit-monotonic seq 7-12, audit_logs 13->19, 0 gap. SSOT pricing recompute working (negative price spoof rejected). PII no leak in audit_logs. Idempotency exact-replay + 409 conflict on payload mismatch. Refund-with-counter-entry creates mirror with parent_order_id, negative totals, RTN-* serial, status=22 Retournée. Composition_snapshot is immutable post-creation (verified via refresh + parent intact post-refund). One watchpoint: composition_snapshot is in fillable() (model layer doesn't block re-write, relies on service discipline). One UX-level item: instruction field accepts raw HTML/<script> tags (DB stores as literal — XSS hardening lives at the renderer; Vue {{}} interpolation auto-escapes, but any v-html consumer would be vulnerable).

watchpoint.description: OrderItem model has composition_snapshot IN fillable[] (cast=array) — no model-layer immutability guard. NF525 invariant relies on service-layer discipline never re-writing post-creation. The fact that immutability isn't model-enforced is by design (NF525 chain HMAC catches tampering downstream), but worth documenting.
watchpoint.mitigation_in_place: audit_logs HMAC chain detects any post-hoc tampering; service-layer (OrderService::posOrderStore) never re-writes.

evidence.parked_order_mechanism: App\Models\PosParkedOrder exists (BranchScope-protected, payload_json + items_count + preview_total + idempotency_token columns) — explicit pause+resume flow for cashier interrupts.

edge_3_long_idle_cashier.rationale: Per advisor: do not sleep 10 minutes. Validation is config-attest + token time-travel verifies TTL math. A 30-min-old token has 449 min remaining = well under 480-min ceiling. Cashier could be interrupted up to ~7h59m and still resume session. Beyond that, explicit pause-via-parked-order is available.

ADV_4_sql_injection_customer_name.mechanism: Laravel Eloquent uses PDO bindValue() — SQL injection physically impossible at the ORM layer. Raw SQL with string concat would be needed to introduce a vulnerability, and the customer create path uses only Eloquent param-binds.
